A complete event/member census identifies eleven zkSync and seven Arbitrum operator EOAs, with six and five admin EOAs respectively, no live system/relay members. Arbitrum proxy administration is an EOA; zkSync proxy administration is a 3-of-6 Safe. Public token-to-fund-unit reconciliation and the provider/native supply contradiction remain unresolved.
mintAuthority.headline: Issuer operators mint without an on-chain reserve cap; Arbitrum upgrades use one key, while zkSync proxy administration uses a three-signature Safe.

review.evidence: Fresh zkSync block 72500706 (2026-10-15T10:46:11Z) and Arbitrum block 515025442 (2026-10-15T09:57:04Z) re-read the unchanged EIP-1967 implementations, administrators and registry bindings. Complete registry histories and pinned member/code reads retain eleven/six operator/admin EOAs on zkSync and seven/five on Arbitrum, with no system/relay members and zero registry multisig slots. Verified implementation and registry artifacts match deployed bytes on both chains. Native operator minting remains economically unbounded; Arbitrum proxy administration remains a no-code single account and zkSync retains a 3-of-6 Safe. The complete Safe extension census, singleton and executable artifact matches were refreshed at the zkSync pin; this does not certify every reachable execution path or the distinct unverified 14496-byte FIUSD EraVM proxy wrapper. Sygnum's daily CBS/database/blockchain report supports internal-ledger semantics only. CoinGecko still reports 3997.66 units while fresh native supply is 1517.66 plus zero, retaining the 2480-unit contradiction. Fidelity's October 14 whole-Class-G-Acc total is 1518.17 units, not a Sygnum fiduciary allocation or independently signed token-to-unit reconciliation. The FINMA register dated October 15 lists exact issuer Sygnum Bank AG in Zurich as an authorised Bank, category 5. Prudential bank supervision is not direct FIUSD product approval. Issuer key custody, beneficial signer independence, native cross-chain reallocation and burn-conservation policy remain unestablished. The aggregate remains unresolved; retained separate historical incident reviews do not certify an incident-free current period.
